01 / Current focus

Selected work.

A lasting memory. A way to connect.
A little device with a bigger purpose.

SAGE FOUNDATION

Intelligence.
For all of us.

A curious mind shouldn't need a better postcode. I'm building the Foundation to help people learn, create and solve problems with local AI, even beyond reliable internet.

Open tools. Knowledge shared deliberately. Networks communities can run themselves. That's the direction behind SAGE Commons and Lantern.

Explore the mission ↗ In formation
SAGE / MEMORY01
A record worth keeping.

SAGE

Available

Your agents shouldn't start over.

Persistent memory for AI agents: decisions, failed approaches and lessons carried into the next session. Local by default, with signed memories, governed access and the CEREBRUM dashboard.

MCPPython SDKApache 2.0
Meet SAGE ↗Source ↗

Lantern

In development

A bigger world, in your hands.

A handheld AI companion for questions, learning and everyday problem-solving beyond reliable internet. Local models, a private SAGE, voice and a camera. Lantern brings the memory and transport work into a device.

Local AIPrivate knowledge
Meet Lantern ↗Working prototypes
MESHTICULUM / TRANSPORT03
Small radios. Wider possibilities.

Meshticulum

Preview

Take the useful bits further.

Experimental transport across LoRa and IP. Recipient-encrypted messages, signed resources and verified chunks, with work on keeping progress through a change of path. Standalone, with its own protocol.

LoRa + IPVerified resources
Explore the project ↗Source ↗

Mynah

Available

Talk to the agent on your Mac.

A personal AI and agent manager reached through Signal text, voice notes or a live call. SAGE keeps its memory, and it can hand work to your other agents. Local models by default, on a Mac you own.

macOSVoice + SignalSAGE memory

03 / The person behind the tabs

That HITB
guy.

HACK IN THE BOX
Since 2003 ↗

I'm Dhillon. Bringing curious people together and building things they can take apart has kept me busy for a while.

I'm the founder and CEO of Hack In The Box, the security conference series running since 2003. Research, deep technical work and the people behind it have always been the interesting part.

Outside that, I'm usually thinking up solutions to problems nobody asked me to solve, or making live modular techno with eurorack as DHANKA.
